name: Pass 30 generalized physical evidence validation
goal: Ensure traceability validation rejects file-like evidence references without supplied instantiated files.
risks: Non-production artifacts could cite evidence filenames that do not exist
Provided evidence files could be unrelated to the records that cite them
Physical evidence validation could remain isolated to production handoff only

nodes.label: Pass 30 generalized evidence critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether non-production artifact evidence can remain file-shaped prose.
node_contract.why: The original transcript requires full project-book evidence, not only production handoff evidence.
node_contract.how: Inspect trace validator, trace schema, validation fixtures, and runner coverage for physical evidence handling.
node_contract.where: df-traceability-evidence validator and DFMS hardening runner.
node_contract.who: Codex using traceability, artifact-governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every new physical-evidence bypass becomes executable validation or an explicit residual risk.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any unproven file-like evidence reference becomes validator logic and a runner fixture.

nodes.label: General trace evidence-file validator implementation

node_contract.what: Extend trace validation with evidence-file bundle checks.
node_contract.why: Artifact, gate, ledger, and certificate evidence files must be physically present in the project book bundle.
node_contract.how: Add --evidence-file parsing, collect file-like evidence obligations, read supplied files, require basename matches and citing-record ID mentions, then add fixtures.
node_contract.where: Installed and workspace df-traceability-evidence validators plus runner.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Complete evidence bundle passes; missing file, bad content, and bad mapping fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every trace evidence validation change.
gates: physical evidence fixtures pass and reject as expected

nodes.label: Pass 30 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Generalized physical-evidence hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 30 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
